Of the 36 programs capture 44515665022 read as not_found, two have their own heading in the 2026-2027 chapter 7 guide and are pinned (Information Technology 33319 to p.46, Esports Entrepreneurship and Live Production - Game Design 46035 to p.96; the college's reconcile entry). The other 34 are filed here as named gaps, each with one of two reasons. Free page reads 45024779831 (pp.45-47, 65-67 and the whole noncredit section, pp.93-100, A to V) and 45025066542 (pp.84-92 and every page in pp.1-92 naming a credit target's title, the interest-area index on pp.3-4 among them) print no heading for any of them; each near-miss page holds other programs. This agrees with S451 (15 credit programs the guide no longer prints under the state's lists) and S593 (18 noncredit certificates the college's noncredit pages do not name; 38975 answers 403). No model call, no Supabase write: no row exists for these programs, and the capture holds no text for them. They are the college's to settle in COCI.
